title: Refreshing selected local values
statement: Let $loc:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, let $y\in\mathbb N$, and let $xs$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Refresh a finite list of integer values by setting, in sequence, the entry at each index in $xs$ to its value under $loc$, extending the list with zeros as needed. The resulting list read at index $y$ equals $loc(y)$ if $y$ occurs in $xs$, and otherwise equals the original list read at $y$.
